title: IoT Event Envelope v1
description: Common envelope every normalized device event carries on the internal event bus (iot.*.v1 topics). Protocol-specific logic stays at the edge; everything inside the platform consumes this shape. See docs/plans/IoT-Platform-Layer-Plan.md §3.

envelopeVersion.description: Version of this envelope shape. Bumped only on a breaking change to the envelope itself (not the payload).

eventId.description: Unique id generated at ingest. Downstream consumers use it as the idempotency/dedup key.

eventType.description: Discriminator selecting the payload schema. Each value maps to a <eventType>.v<schemaVersion>.json payload schema.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the payload schema for this eventType. Lets payloads evolve independently of the envelope.

deviceId.description: Device registry id of the emitting device — NOT the bus id.

busId.description: Bus the device was assigned to at ingest, resolved from the registry. Null when the device is unassigned.

tripId.description: Active trip for the bus at the event time, if one was resolved. Null otherwise.

deviceTimestamp.description: When the device says the event occurred (device clock — may be wrong or late).

ingestedAt.description: When the platform received the event (server clock, authoritative for ordering-by-arrival).

sequenceNo.description: Monotonic per-device counter when the device provides one. Combined with deviceId, a secondary dedup/ordering key. Optional — not every source emits it.

source.description: Where the event entered the platform.

adapter.description: Ingestion adapter that produced this envelope.

gateway.description: Identifier of the ingesting instance (for tracing/debugging).

payload.description: Event body. Its shape is defined by the <eventType>.v<schemaVersion> payload schema and validated separately.
